params.name: Tilt
params.desc: Controls the tone of the selected Character effect.

params.name: Rate
params.desc: Sets the modulation speed/rate.

params.name: Time
params.desc: Sets the delay time or reverb size.

params.name: Mix
params.desc: Blends between input signal and effected signal.

params.name: Character amount
params.desc: Adjusts the intensity of the Character effect.

params.name: Movement amount
params.desc: Adjusts the intensity/depth of the Movement effect.

params.name: Diffusion amount
params.desc: Adjusts the repeats/feedback/mix of the Diffusion effect.

params.name: Texture amount
params.desc: Adjusts the cutoff or intensity of the Texture effect.

params.name: Sensitivity
params.desc: Fine-tunes drive headroom or swell threshold.

params.name: Drift (Movement)
params.desc: Adds random pitch shifts or warble to Movement module effects.

params.name: Drift (Diffusion)
params.desc: Adds pitch modulation or tape degradation to Diffusion module effects.

params.name: Output level
params.desc: Attenuates or boosts the FX output level.

params.name: Character effect volume
params.desc: Adjusts the output volume of the Character module.

params.name: Movement effect volume
params.desc: Adjusts the output volume of the Movement module.

params.name: Diffusion effect volume
params.desc: Adjusts only the Diffusion wet effect volume.

params.name: Texture effect volume
params.desc: Adjusts the output volume of the Texture module.

params.name: Character module
params.desc: Selects the active Character effect or bypasses the module.

params.name: Movement module
params.usage: 0-21: Doubler; 22-43: Vibrato; 44-65: Phaser; 66-87: Tremolo; 88-109: Pitch; 110-127: Off
params.desc: Selects the active Movement effect or bypasses the module.

params.name: Diffusion module
params.usage: 0-21: Cascade; 22-43: Reels; 44-65: Space; 66-87: Collage; 88-109: Reverse; 110-127: Off
params.desc: Selects the active Diffusion effect or bypasses the module.

params.name: Texture module
params.usage: 0-21: Filter; 22-43: Squash; 44-65: Cassette; 66-87: Broken; 88-109: Interference; 110-127: Off
params.desc: Selects the active Texture effect or bypasses the module.

params.name: Bypass
params.desc: Engages or disengages Chroma Console.

params.name: Dual bypass
params.usage: 0-31: Total bypass; 32-63: Dual bypass; 64-127: Total engage
params.desc: Sets standard or dual bypass mode.

params.name: Character module bypass
params.desc: Bypasses or engages the Character module.

params.name: Movement module bypass
params.desc: Bypasses or engages the Movement module.

params.name: Diffusion module bypass
params.desc: Bypasses or engages the Diffusion module.

params.name: Texture module bypass
params.desc: Bypasses or engages the Texture module.

params.name: Gesture play/record
params.desc: Controls playback and recording of knob movements.

params.name: Gesture stop/erase
params.desc: Stops or erases recorded gestures.

params.name: Capture control
params.desc: Controls looper/sustainer recording and playback.

params.name: Capture routing
params.desc: Routes Capture looper before or after effects.

params.name: Tap tempo
params.desc: Sends tap tempo input.

params.name: Filter style
params.desc: Selects low-pass filter (LPF), tilt filter, or high-pass filter (HPF) style for Texture module.

params.name: Calibration headroom level
params.desc: Sets the input level calibration headroom.

params.name: Calibration menu
params.desc: Enters or exits the calibration menu.
